name: Clearing
why: Round 4 of Clearing: the slow build. The two instruments and the hands open it, played with small human variations; the kick waits while the percussion and a few hats grow; the bass is your off-beat motif from "Back, changed", a two-bar groove, developed in the middle and strong at the clearing; the hush's pad pulses on the beat, opening bar by bar, the hats rising into the drop.

sections.name: Clearing: First light
sections.why: The two instruments and the hands, each played with small variations (Life: light); the drops developed over four bars.

sections.name: Clearing: Footsteps
sections.why: Still no kick: twigs and an insect join the hands, a few closed hats come in.

sections.name: Clearing: The path
sections.why: The kick arrives; the hats play like a drummer (ghosts, accents, an open hat, a fill every fourth bar); leaves in the percussion.

sections.name: Clearing: The bass arrives
sections.why: The bass: your off-beat motif as a two-bar groove, the second bar answering (a repeated note, one a 16th early, a pickup).

sections.name: Clearing: Undergrowth
sections.why: The bass steps out; open hats; the marimba climbing.

sections.name: Clearing: Back, changed
sections.why: On D minor: the motif developed over four bars (as it was, answered, turned, coming home), the hands answering each other with a bamboo fill.

sections.name: Clearing: Hush
sections.why: The pad pulsing on every beat, its filter opening bar by bar; the forest's crackle; the hats coming in after four bars and rising into the drop.

sections.name: Clearing: The clearing
sections.why: The drop: the pad open and pumping, the bass motif strong and steady under it, the hats jamming (Life: loose).

sections.name: Clearing: Last light
sections.why: The kick thins, the bass holds long notes on the and.

name: Two rivers
why: Round 4 of Two rivers: the rondo you liked, its bass line and percussion kept, the melody sparse; now every section ends on a hat fill into the next, the wood river without percussion (as you set it), the pad swelling in the wood river with no kick and staying for the sea, and an estuary to close.

name: Undertow
why: Round 4 of Undertow: one idea throughout, on its two chords (A minor 9 to E minor 9) the whole way: the bass on the beat one bar and off it the next, and every other part locking to it. The hats play the other way from the bass, the hands fill its gaps, the drops echo its figure up high, and at the surface the marimba carries it while the bass rests. It opens on the hands and long bass notes you liked.
